acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Celestials family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Guardian, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Halo-Brace Line Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: An idealized armored humanoid in polished gold plate with full two-wing span, a solid ring halo, a long spear, and a round shield sized to align with the halo.

Signature mechanic: Golden Diameter: the Guardian places shield and spear on opposite ends of its solid halo's projected line. The two full wings brace symmetrically and the spear thrusts down that diameter; rotation is impossible until the shield grip releases.
battlefieldDuty: Hold a repeatable luminous line by aligning round shield, spear, full two-wing span, and solid ring halo, then thrust only after the formation locks.
constructionDimensions: Ordered regalia becomes a hydraulic liturgy through pearl-inlaid halo channels, translucent reservoirs within marble armor, wet silk ribbons, shell valves at wing roots, and fluid ring bearings scaled to each tier's halo complexity.

Actions show coherent filling and drainage: clear fluid advances beneath script, selected feathers lock under pressure, wet reflections reveal moving ring sections, and pressure loss exposes the central bearing.
counterplay: Move across the diameter rather than away from the spear, displace the shield grip, or strike the rear wing root while the thrust and opposite wing remain fixed. Affinity signal: A pearl valve lifts as the selected halo or wing pair fills; opening it drains that axis and reveals the otherwise luminous binding core.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only water treatment without reservoirs, valves, wet materials, and pressure routing
Glow-only water treatment without coherent filling and drainage
Shapeless blue light or liquid bodies that erase celestial anatomy and geometry
Sky-blue family-native color presented as Water affinity without hydraulic construction
identityInvariants: An idealized upright humanoid silhouette remains deliberately symmetrical, with feathered wings and a halo above or behind the head even as the body becomes increasingly abstract.
White, ivory, pale gold, sunlight yellow, and sky blue remain family-native ordered radiance rather than elemental affinity colors.
Polished gold, white marble, feather, silk, and source-native pure light stay layered so armor, cloth, wing roots, halo joints, and the suggested body remain readable.
Halos, ring geometry, sacred script, ribbons, censers, blank ceremonial masks, and wing count communicate rank through exact symmetry and moving parts rather than glow or size alone.
Escalation increases wing pairs and halo complexity from a simple ring to an orrery, but each tier preserves a breakable alignment joint and a learnable ordered command.
telegraph: Gold plate settles, the round shield centers on one side of the halo, the spear tip reaches the opposite side, and both wing roots lock at equal angles.
